package.name: urdf_live_editor
package.description: Deterministic core for the ROS 2 Live URDF Editor: URDF loading, validation, the staged-edit pipeline, the Milestone 5 observability (structured logging, diagnostics, audit trail) and launch/config integration modules, and the Milestone 6 extensions (ros2_control generation, Gazebo simulation artifacts, multi-model sessions, and collision/inertial validation).
